youtube.tagsNote: Commas between tags count, and a tag with a space counts as if it had quote marks around it
youtube.noAngleBrackets: Titles and descriptions can't contain < or >

thumbnail.recommended: 3840 x 2160 for videos, 2160 x 3840 for Shorts
thumbnail.weMake: 1920 x 1080 JPG, kept under 2 MB so it uploads from a phone too
thumbnail.verified: Custom thumbnails need a verified account
thumbnail.shortsWhere: Custom Shorts thumbnails can only be added in YouTube Studio on a computer

vertical.file: MP4, H.264 high profile, yuv420p, AAC 48 kHz stereo, faststart, under 25 MB for the 127 Library
vertical.textMargins: Our layout rule, not a platform number: titles sit below the top 270 px and captions end above the bottom 670 px, with 65 px on the sides and extra room on the right, where Reels, TikTok and Shorts put their buttons and captions

notVerified.note: We could not verify these today, so the outputs say check current rules instead of a number

captionFiles.vtt: WebVTT, starts with WEBVTT, HH:MM:SS.mmm timestamps
captionFiles.note: 42 characters and 2 lines per cue is our reading-speed rule for caption files, not a platform limit
